title: Limits on new swimming pools in West Maui
summary: A bill heard at the January 2026 council meeting restricts West Maui pools through December 31, 2030, with rebuilding of fire-destroyed pools exempt; the Board of Water Supply and Maui Planning Commission supported it. In September 2026 a resident told the Board of Water Supply that new pools could mainly use captured rainwater.

timeline.text: A resident suggested new West Maui pools could mainly use captured rainwater rather than drinking water.
